item.title: Mortgage rates fall below 6 percent for first time in over 3 years
item.description: Mortgage rates fell below 6 percent on Thursday for the first time in over three years, marking an opening for home buyers as inflation cools.

item.title: Clinton deposition paused after Boebert leaks photo to conservative influencer
item.description: On Thursday, a deposition involving former secretary of state Hillary Clinton was paused after Rep. Lauren Boebert (R-Colo.) leaked a photo of Clinton to a conservative influencer.

item.title: Court docs name D4vd as target of Celeste Rivas Hernandez murder investigation; new gruesome details revealed
item.description: Court documents made public in the alleged homicide of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez reveal gruesome new details about the death of the teenager and identify singer D4vd as the investigation’s central target.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery: Paramount's hostile bid 'superior' to Netflix offer
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery, the sprawling entertainment company that owns major media brands like HBO and CNN, said on Thursday it now favors a bid made by Paramount to buy the company's key assets over a previous agreement with streamer Netflix.

item.title: Mountain lion snatches dog right in front of owner in California
item.description: A Southern California woman is devastated after her beloved Shih Tzu was snatched by a mountain lion right in front of her late Monday night.

item.title: Man buries neighbor's car in snow in 'blizzard rage' dispute
item.description: The man was caught on camera burying his neighbor's SUV under a tall mound of snow, one shovelful at a time.

item.title: Netflix declines to raise its offer to buy Warner, says deal is 'no longer financially attractive'
item.description: Netflix is declining to raise its offer to buy Warner Bros. Discovery’s studio and streaming business, in a stunning move that effectively puts Paramount in a position to take over the fellow storied Hollywood giant.

item.title: Tampa man killed in Cuban boat shootout wanted to overthrow island's government, loved ones say
item.description: The family and friends of Michel Ortega Casanova said he was one of four men killed in an armed confrontation off the Cuban Coast.

item.title: Kansas invalidates 1K+ transgender residents' driver's licenses, birth certificates
item.description: A Kansas law invalidating the driver’s licenses and birth certificates of transgender residents who changed their gender on the documents took effect Thursday.
